title: Chapter 120
text:
Time moved forward.

Two hours ago.

"Holy sh * t, I finally succeeded!"

Han Xiao's surprised voice could be heard on the Fabian Military Arms Transport Aircraft.

A brand new sniper rifle was lying quietly on the workbench. Its design was very different from the gunpowder sniper rifle. It was dark green in color and looked very thick. It was wide at the front and narrow in the middle. It had clear edges and corners, and the stock was hollow. It looked like a triangular bracket.

The entire barrel was half embedded in the body of the gun. The exposed part of the barrel was exposed to the air, and the coil and wire were tightly intertwined.

The gun was 0.87 meters long and was equipped with an optical multi-scope. It was also equipped with an electromagnetic scanning multi-scope. The two scopes could be used interchangeably.

Successful. Searching database … Matching blueprints found.

You have received the blueprint [Ghost Sniper Rifle (Incomplete)]!

["Ghost" Gauss Sniper Rifle (Incomplete)]

Type: Light Electromagnetic Sniper Rifle

Quality: White

Basic Stats: 183-246 Attack Rate: 2 shots/s Magazine Capacity: 16 shots/s Range: 1,100 meters Damage Level: 144

Requirements: 45 DEX, Sniper Lv 6

Ammunition Type: Magnetic Ammunition

Length: 0.87 meters

Weight: 12.6 pounds

Additional Effect: Low Recoil – The recoil of the electromagnetic gun is lower. Slightly increases the accuracy of the shot.

Incomplete Limitation 1: Power, Speed, and Range are lower than the complete version.

Incomplete Limitation 2: Due to the lack of technology, the energy consumption is very high. Each shot will consume 10 Ona's energy. (Battery Capacity: 180)

Incomplete Limitation 3: Due to the lack of technology, some materials will be damaged after 20 to 30 shots, and the parts will need to be replaced.

Requirements: Advanced Electromagnetism Lv. 1 (Incomplete), Basic Energy Theory Lv. 5 (Incomplete), Basic Weaponry Lv. 5 (Incomplete)

"What a pleasant surprise!" Han Xiao was a little happy. He had only wanted to tinker with his own invention, and he did not expect to get an incomplete version of the blueprint. This meant that as long as the knowledge was in place, he would be able to get the complete version of the blueprint.

The Ghost sniper rifle was a stable light electromagnetic weapon. Han Xiao was currently lacking two key pieces of knowledge, and the core of the knowledge was the advanced knowledge that was extremely difficult to obtain. He was already very satisfied that he was able to create an incomplete version of the sniper rifle.

Even if the Ghost Gauss Sniper Rifle was an incomplete version, its output was still two to three times more efficient than the Red Falcon. Furthermore, electromagnetic weapons usually had an "over-the-horizon" range, and the incomplete version did not show that yet.

As for the limitation of the defect, Han Xiao also had a temporary solution, which was to create enough backup batteries. This way, he would not have to worry about the high energy consumption. The only problem was that it would cost a lot of money … but this was not a problem at all for the rich Technician Han. He had plenty of money. Ghost's material problem was handled in the same way. All they had to do was prepare the replacement materials.

The ammunition of electromagnetic weapons was different from that of gunpowder weapons. It required special magnetic pellets or conductors, and it was impossible to use the special ammunition from before. This was a big problem, but given some time, he could integrate the principle of special ammunition into the magnetic pellets. However, in the short term, only gunpowder weapons could use special ammunition, so he was not prepared to throw away the Red Falcon.

Then, Han Xiao created two clips of magnetic ammunition.

At this time, his eyelids suddenly became heavy, and fatigue surged up like a tide. He held on to the table and took a deep breath for three seconds.

Last night, he had not slept at all. First, he had completed the [Return the Antique] prize-pool mission. Then, he had fought with the Invisible Demon and treated his wounds hastily. After that, he had started to develop new firearms without stopping until night fell. His body could take it, but his mental fatigue had been accumulating.

"That's it for today."

Han Xiao rubbed his eyes and turned off the lathe. The buzzing workshop quieted down, and the cold metal returned to its deathly stillness.

The people on the plane were resting, and Han Xiao did not want to stay here. He took his equipment, found a car, and prepared to rush back to the manor overnight. This way, he could avoid the situation where he could not make it in time if something unexpected happened tonight.

With Brother Xiao's keen sense of smell, he smelled a strong scent of a flag from Wang Yuan's order to return to the manor by tomorrow morning. He had a hunch that if he really went back tomorrow morning, he might miss something, so Han Xiao decided to be cautious.

…

After driving tiredly for a long time, he soon arrived at the forest outside the manor.

Suddenly, a bolt of lightning shot up into the sky and reflected on his retina. Han Xiao shuddered and hurriedly braked.

"An enemy is attacking the manor? F * ck, this is indeed a flag! " Han Xiao cursed in his heart and hurriedly turned off the engine. He carried his equipment and sneaked up to the tree. He took out his binoculars to observe the battle outside the manor and was shocked.

"If it's not a hidden character that I don't know, there are only four people in the Blue Star who have this level of control over electricity. Deuce of Lightning, Electric Eye, Ember Lightning, and a Germinal Organization executive officer. This person's lightning ability has extremely strong impact and can also release EMP, but it seems like it can only be released externally and cannot be used to stimulate the body's activity through electricity. Then, his physique should be electricity resistance, not electricity affinity … This should be Ember Lightning's performance!"

Another famous person in the Blue Star!

After observing for a while, he finally saw Bennett walk out of the manor. Han Xiao's eyes flashed, and he knew that he should not make a move. Suddenly, he realized that the hidden requirement of the fifth round was probably to solve all the problems by himself and not give Bennett a chance to make a move. Only this could explain the difference of ten times between the mission reward and the special reward.

With that in mind, Han Xiao immediately picked up the Ghost sniper rifle, opened the scope, and aimed at Ember Lightning from afar.

"Flaming Will!" Han Xiao yelled in a low voice.

Don't be mistaken, there was no need to shout to trigger the skill. He just felt that it would be more exciting this way, and the chances of Ember Lightning would be higher.

One-tenth of his energy was instantly depleted.

You have added [Flaming Will]!

Your next attack will deal 180% base damage!

Ha, what did I say? How can I get a critical hit without shouting the skill name?

Han Xiao immediately pulled the trigger. The electromagnetic gun shook slightly, and the exposed part of the gun suddenly lit up with blue electricity. The special magnetic needle bullet was fired out of the gun and disappeared from sight with a flash of blue light. The initial speed of the bullet was about twice as fast as the gunpowder gun, making it more difficult for the enemy to react.

The recoil was very small, and the impact on accuracy was negligible.

The needle bullet with blue light penetrated Ember Lightning's body in an instant, and Ember Lightning had no time to dodge.

The bullet hit his heart, and a cloud of blood burst out.

Damage notifications appeared on the interface like a stream of water!

You have dealt 200% Sneak Attack Critical Hit to Ember Lightning (LV 48)!

You have dealt 200% Critical Hit to Ember Lightning (LV 48)!

This attack has gained the bonus of [Flaming Will], base damage is 190 (theoretical damage) x 180% = 342!

This attack has gained the bonus of Critical Hit, 342 x 400% = 1,368 Damage!

You have dealt 1,175 Damage to Ember Lightning! (Damage reduction has been calculated)

You have dealt a heavy blow to Ember Lightning's heart, dealing more than one-third of the target's maximum HP!

Ember Lightning has entered a state of severe bleeding, losing 2% HP every second for 10 seconds.

Ember Lightning has entered a state of paralysis, unable to move, Defense reduced by 30% for 3 seconds.

Ember Lightning has entered a state of weakness, all attributes reduced by 50% for 30 seconds.

Ember Lightning spat out a mouthful of blood and knelt on the ground. His heart had been pierced, and all his strength was draining away. He looked in the direction where the bullet came from, his eyes filled with pain and disbelief.

Bennett was also shocked. Even if Ember Lightning was an Esper and had a relatively average physique, he had the protection of energy. How could he have been hit so badly by a sniper's bullet? The power of this shot was beyond his imagination!

"How can I die here?!" Ember Lightning, who had been so arrogant just a moment ago, was extremely frightened. His face was pale as he gritted his teeth and endured the pain.

Before he could finish his thought, Han Xiao, who was hiding in the dark, fired again. A stream of blood spurted out of Ember Lightning's left eye, and the bullet drilled into his brain.

The third shot followed closely. It also drilled into Ember Lightning's left eye, sending his skull flying. Red and white matter splattered all over the ground.

"Fatal Attack!"

Ember Lightning fell to the ground. His other intact eye was filled with frozen shock and indignation.

The whole place was silent.

These three shots were like the scythe of the Grim Reaper, silent but deadly. They carried the aura of a ruler of life and death, as if they were filled with the aura of death. It stunned the whole place!

Bennett sucked in a breath of cold air.

Three shots!

Only three shots!

An Esper criminal, who could fight an army head-on, who made the special agents and superheroes of various countries helpless, was killed in an instant!

The surrounding mercenaries were shocked. The development of the situation was completely out of their expectations.

That unstoppable enemy like the God of Thunder was killed in three shots just like that?

Unbelievable!

In the car of Division 13, Di Su Su's eyes were wide open, and her voice was trembling.
